scope: Read-only caller census; follow-on node owns all listed source paths.
reachability_rule: Whether the authored entry point currently constructs an own-node carrier. Generic helpers can require migration before reuse on another carrier even when their current driver is raster-only.

callers.reason: _candidate_table is called with analytic-oracle operators built by oracle_fixture.forward_operator; these declare six direct sampling vertices per cell.
_machine_and_field builds the analytic single-null hex carrier and its direct sampling targets.

Authored driver uses _mast_case_from_selection and _passive_inclusive_case. build_profile constructs a tensor raster with use_linear_moments=False and no sample target; connectivity_grid_axes also requires a tensor lattice.
All three authored families come from tests.test_connectivity_boundary._forward_operator, which constructs a FluxLattice, no sample target and use_linear_moments=False.
Authored MAST wall rungs replace only the wall of the same raster passive profile; the grid has no direct sample targets.
prepare_labeller delegates to the shared MAST raster profile; _prepared_with_polarity only changes polarity, so it introduces no own-node sample geometry.
load_row rebuilds the cached analytic hex carrier with oracle_fixture.forward_operator and then strips the terminal state to its grid prefix.
_profile_and_seed uses the passive MAST raster profile; its tensor-fit benchmark assumes that raster shape.
Authored driver uses the passive MAST raster profile and a reshaped tensor connectivity read.
The benchmark reads analytic hex machines with direct sampling targets; it truncates before both _fixed_design_read and read_census.
Authored driver builds the passive MAST raster profile. Its topology snapshot then requires connectivity_grid_axes.
The wall-coupling diagnostic operates on cached analytic hex carrier machines with direct sampling targets and truncates before read and census.
_profile_and_seed supplies the shared passive MAST raster profile. The legacy helper and structured helper both accept grid-only values; a future own-node input would need migration.
ForwardProfile._secondary_x_point is generic and can receive an operator with direct authored sample targets; its current split discards those values.
